title: CSV to Markdown Table
seoTitle: CSV to Markdown Table — Free Online Converter
description: Convert CSV data into a clean Markdown table ready to paste into GitHub, Notion or any Markdown document. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Paste comma-separated values and get a properly formatted Markdown table with headers. No upload, no account, instant result.
blurb: Turn CSV into a Markdown table in one click — free and private.
howItWorks: Paste your CSV into the input box. The first row is treated as column headers.
Choose the delimiter if it is not a comma, then press Convert to Markdown.
Copy the resulting table and paste it into a Markdown file, README or wiki.
examples:
Input: name,score
Alice,95
Bob,87 → Output: | name | score |
| --- | --- |
| Alice | 95 |
| Bob | 87 |
Use tab-separated data exported from a spreadsheet by selecting the Tab delimiter.

faq.q: Does the first row become the header?
faq.a: Yes. The first non-empty row is always used as the Markdown table header row.

faq.q: What if my data contains commas?
faq.a: Quoted fields are handled correctly, so a value like "Smith, John" stays in one cell.
No. Conversion happens entirely inside your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
